alternate_mechanisms.title: Retention, burden, and visible sign
alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: The earth functions as retaining ground that bears a hidden load until divine activation converts containment into emergence and emergence into a visible sign. Pregnancy and livestock imagery remain analogical, but they explain the passage's repeated hidden-burden-to-manifest-outcome transition.

alternate_mechanisms.title: Truth audit against performed appearance
alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: The earth's tested report and the direct showing of deeds audit both false attribution and self-presentational display. What agents say or stage is subordinated to what the commanded witness reports and what the final showing makes manifest.

alternate_mechanisms.title: Directed procession and visible partition
alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: Lordship can be preserved as direction of a procession: people issue forth along outcome-bearing routes, become visibly spaced into groups, and receive separately displayed portions. alternate_mechanisms.title: Granular allotment

alternate_mechanisms.title: Guidance and choice before compulsory seeing
alternate_mechanisms.mechanism: A latent prehistory of judgment remains available: guidance may be sought, a better course may be chosen, and deeds may be intentionally enacted before the final moment when their disclosure is no longer optional.

alternate_mechanisms.title: Material preparation and dispersion
